visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair sits on a grey sofa in a brightly lit indoor room. He is wearing a grey long-sleeved button-down shirt and holds an orange book in his lap. Behind him are several colorful decorative pillows featuring a YouTube play button and stylized animal faces. A large red-and-white banner with text and illustrations is positioned at the top of the frame. (2) A graphic map of East Asia appears on screen. A hand enters from the right to place a yellow pin with a small Japanese flag onto an island located between Taiwan and Japan. (3) The scene cuts back to the man on the sofa. He gestures with his right hand, pointing upwards while speaking to the camera. Large variety-style text boxes with green and red backgrounds appear around him. (4) Close-up footage shows a metal hoe striking dry, light-brown soil in a field. The camera angle is low, focusing on the impact of the tool. (5) Wide shots of agricultural fields follow, first showing rows of low green pineapple plants, and then tall stalks of sugarcane swaying in the wind. The sky is slightly overcast but bright. (6) A short clip of a person in a dark field setting off a pink smoke flare is shown. The lighting is dim, contrasting with the bright pink smoke. (7) Final shot returns to the man on the sofa. He gestures broadly with both hands as more variety text and social media calls-to-action appear on screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 最有畫面感的臺灣史. [Variety]: 歷史老師. [Slogan]: 真的問什麼都答得出來嗎？ (2) [Subtitle]: 日本的石垣島竟然有臺灣的風獅爺. (3) [Subtitle]: 臺灣人帶過去的. [Variety]: 蛤為什麼？？ (4) [Subtitle]: 為什麼？ (5) [Subtitle]: 日治時期日本推行了一個八重山振興計畫. (6) [Subtitle]: 要把石垣島跟附近的小島產業振興一下. (7) [Subtitle]: 大概在1930年代到二戰之前. (8) [Subtitle]: 約莫有1,200位臺灣人接受徵召來到了石垣島進行產業開發. (9) [Variety]: 那為什麼要找臺灣人. (10) [Subtitle]: 很近啊！石垣島隸屬於沖繩縣. (11) [Subtitle]: 但是它離沖繩縣主要的行政中心那霸市410公里. (12) [Subtitle]: 但離台灣270公里. (13) [Subtitle]: 搭飛機的話還比你到金門跟馬祖還要近. (14) [Variety]: 也太近了吧. (15) [Subtitle]: 這1,000多人來到石垣島從事了很多工作. (16) [Subtitle]: 挖煤礦. (17) [Subtitle]: 把臺灣的種植產業帶過去. (18) [Subtitle]: 種鳳梨 & 種甘蔗. (19) [Subtitle]: 到今天如果你去石垣島你還會看到到處都有鳳梨田和甘蔗田. (20) [Subtitle]: 這就是臺灣人帶過去的. (21) [Subtitle]: 不過他們去那邊其實蠻辛苦. (22) [Subtitle]: 除了離鄉背井之外，臺灣人的身分還是會受到當地日本人的歧視. (23) [Subtitle]: 早期他們甚至會隱瞞自己臺灣人的身分. (24) [Subtitle]: 1945年二戰結束之後許多人就回到了臺灣. (25) [Subtitle]: 不過也有上百人他們選擇繼續留在石垣島落地生根. (26) [Subtitle]: 成為了台裔日本人. (27) [Subtitle]: 今天如果你去石垣島會發現... (28) [Variety]: 哇!滿滿的臺灣味. (29) [Subtitle]: 日本土地上獨特的台灣風景就是由這群台裔日本人創造出來的. (30) [Slogan]: 留言「台灣史」告訴你更多台灣歷史故事哦.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a bouncy, mid-tempo acoustic guitar track accompanied by a steady percussion beat. A male voice begins a professional, friendly narration in Traditional Chinese. A female voice briefly enters with a high-pitched, inquisitive tone, asking a rhetorical question. (2) A digital 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition. The male voice explains historical context regarding Ishigaki Island. The BGM maintains a consistent level under the vocals. (3) A sharp 'ding' sound effect emphasizes the appearance of on-screen text. The male narrator's speech rate remains steady and clear. (4) Percussive thudding sounds, simulating the impact of farm tools, are heard briefly as the dialogue mentions agriculture. (5) The narration continues over the music, detailing the post-war migration patterns. The vocal energy remains moderately high. (6) A final 'ping' sound effect occurs near the end as the female voice reacts with a short exclamation of surprise. The music continues briefly before a clean hard cut at the finish.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the historical and geographic link between Taiwan and Japan's Ishigaki Island, specifically how Taiwanese immigrants shaped the island's agricultural industry and local culture during and after the Japanese colonial period.
